tnbc_pt01_ac_t_resistant_basal.title: Patient TNBC-01: Basal-Like 1 (BL1) Neoadjuvant AC-T Chemoresistant
tnbc_pt01_ac_t_resistant_basal.citation: Lehmann et al. (2011) JCI; Balko et al. (2014) Cancer Discovery

clinical_history.primary_driver: TP53 mutation, EGFR overexpression, CDKN2A loss, MYC amplification, intact BRCA
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Neoadjuvant AC-T (Adriamycin + Cyclophosphamide followed by Paclitaxel)
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Extensive residual cancer burden (RCB-III) at mastectomy, liver metastasis at 6.2 months, death at 13.5 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: High baseline EGFR and MEK/ERK survival loops; p53 mutation prevents DNA-damage checkpoint apoptosis

tnbc_pt02_brca1_parp_inhibitor_resistant.title: Patient TNBC-02: Germline BRCA1-Mutated with Secondary PARP Inhibitor Resistance
tnbc_pt02_brca1_parp_inhibitor_resistant.citation: Robson et al. (2017) NEJM OlympiAD Trial; TCGA-BRCA Germline Cohort

clinical_history.primary_driver: Germline BRCA1 mutation (185delAG), TP53 mutation, PTEN loss
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Transient partial response for 4.5 months, then fulminant pleural and brain progression, death at 11.0 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Loss of PTEN hyperactivated Akt, stabilizing XIAP and shutting down mitochondrial apoptosis despite PARP-induced replication stress

tnbc_pt03_mesenchymal_met_driven.title: Patient TNBC-03: Mesenchymal Metaplastic TNBC (c-MET / Hypoxia Driven)
tnbc_pt03_mesenchymal_met_driven.citation: Lehmann et al. (2011) JCI; TCGA-BRCA Metaplastic Subgroup

clinical_history.primary_driver: High c-MET activation, severe hypoxic tumor core, TP53 mutation, EMT phenotype
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary chemoresistance, rapid chest wall recurrence and lung nodules at 4.1 months, death at 9.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: HGF/MET autocrine loop driving STAT3 and NF-kB; massive MCL-1 and BCL-xL anti-apoptotic shield

tnbc_pt04_brca_intact_exceptional_pcr.title: Patient TNBC-04: Exceptional Pathological Complete Response (pCR Cured Survivor)
tnbc_pt04_brca_intact_exceptional_pcr.citation: TCGA-BRCA Long-Term Disease-Free Cohort; Balko et al. (2014)

clinical_history.primary_driver: Wild-type TP53, intact PTEN, low anti-apoptotic defenses
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Pathological complete response (pCR = ypT0 ypN0) at definitive resection, disease-free survival >60 months (SURVIVED / Remission)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Intact p53 apoptotic priming; functional mitochondrial apoptotic cascade without anti-apoptotic shielding

tnbc_pt05_pten_null_pik3ca_activated.title: Patient TNBC-05: PTEN-Null PI3K/Akt Hyperactive Refractory TNBC
tnbc_pt05_pten_null_pik3ca_activated.citation: Montagud et al. (2019) PLoS Comput. Biol.; Lehmann et al. (2011)

clinical_history.primary_driver: PTEN deletion, activating PIK3CA-H1047R mutation, TP53 mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete lack of response, rapid symptomatic progression in bone and lymph nodes at 3.5 months, death at 8.0 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Constitutive Akt/mTOR phosphorylation blocks apoptosis by stabilizing XIAP and inactivating pro-apoptotic Bad/Bax

tnbc_pt06_myc_mcl1_coamplified.title: Patient TNBC-06: 1q21 MCL1 and 8q24 MYC Co-Amplified Aggressive TNBC
tnbc_pt06_myc_mcl1_coamplified.citation: Balko et al. (2014) Cancer Discovery; TCGA-BRCA 1q21 Cohort

clinical_history.primary_driver: Genomic co-amplification of MCL1 (1q21) and MYC (8q24), TP53 mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Fulminant disease progression with inflammatory breast carcinoma features during treatment, death at 7.4 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Genomic amplification of MCL-1 directly clamps mitochondrial outer membrane, neutralizing all cytotoxic agents

tnbc_pt07_hypoxic_stem_metastatic.title: Patient TNBC-07: Hypoxic CD44+/CD24- Breast Cancer Stem-Like Metastatic Niche
tnbc_pt07_hypoxic_stem_metastatic.citation: Lehmann et al. (2011) JCI; TCGA-BRCA Stem Cell Subgroup

clinical_history.primary_driver: Hypoxia / HIF1A high, constitutive NF-kB, TP53 mutation, PTEN loss
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Chemo-tolerant stem cells survived; distant visceral crisis in liver at 5.0 months, death at 10.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Hypoxic dormancy and NF-kB-mediated upregulation of c-FLIP and XIAP, completely silencing both death receptor and mitochondrial caspases

tnbc_pt08_pan_resistant_post_immunothera.title: Patient TNBC-08: Pan-Refractory Post-Immunotherapy / Sacituzumab Failure
tnbc_pt08_pan_resistant_post_immunothera.citation: Schmid et al. (2018) NEJM IMpassion130; TCGA-BRCA Multi-Line Failure

clinical_history.primary_driver: Pan-RTK co-activation (EGFR + c-MET), PIK3CA mutation, PTEN loss, TP53 mutation, NF-kB hyperactive
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Atezolizumab (anti-PD-L1) + Nab-Paclitaxel followed by Sacituzumab Govitecan (anti-TROP2 ADC)
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Refractory to all systemic therapies, rapid leptomeningeal and brain metastases, death at 5.6 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Dual-RTK redundancy (EGFR + MET) with dual loss of p53 and PTEN, creating a multi-layer anti-apoptotic block (MCL1 + BCLxL + XIAP)
